name: sharepoint
description: Browse Microsoft SharePoint sites, document libraries, files, and lists.

TENANT_ID.title: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
TENANT_ID.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft 365 tenant that hosts your SharePoint sites (Microsoft Entra admin center → App registrations → your app → Overview). Inserted into the Agent 365 server URL.

CLIENT_ID.title: Microsoft Entra application (client) ID
CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of the public-client app registration that has been granted the Work IQ SharePoint MCP server permission and lists Cursor's OAuth callback URLs as redirect URIs.
